name: Maltitol
siboNotes: Maltitol is a polyol that feeds SIBO bacteria and can cause significant digestive distress even in small amounts. Avoid completely during SIBO treatment phases.
preparationTips: Check ingredient labels carefully as maltitol is common in sugar-free products
Be aware that 'sugar-free' doesn't mean FODMAP-free
Start with tiny amounts if testing tolerance
May cause laxative effects even in healthy individuals
pairsWellWith: Should be avoided on low-FODMAP diet
Consider natural sweetness from low-FODMAP fruits
Pair alternatives with compliant baking ingredients
Use with low-FODMAP flours for baking
Combine with permitted spices like cinnamon
nutritionalHighlights: May help with blood sugar control
Does not contribute to tooth decay
